description: Motivating the Agricultural Community to Build Climate Resilience is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Purdue University | Cooperative Extension Service; USDA Useful to Usable Project; Purdue University. Climate change adaptation isn’t always welcome as a topic of conversation, even among those who could benefit from it. A recent study hints at a possible path forward. Coverage: the United States (2015). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. outcomes: Over the last decade, Purdue Extension educator Hans Schmitz has watched farmers across the U.S. Corn Belt struggle to cope with the consequences of extreme climate conditions. For instance, heavy spring rainfall in 2011 reduced farmers’ ability to get into their fields and delayed their planting.
